Featured Projects

01

Centennial College · MKTG 746002 · Aug 2024

Bank Customer Term Loan Prediction

Full predictive analysis on a Portuguese bank marketing dataset to identify customers most likely to subscribe to a term deposit. Applied Decision Trees, Logistic Regression, and Neural Networks in SAS Enterprise Miner, comparing all models systematically.

Key Results

  • 3-split Decision Tree: lowest ASE of 0.065925 among all tree models
  • Backward Regression: best regression model, validation ASE = 0.072082
  • Neural Network (3 hidden units): overall winner, validation ASE = 0.064749
  • Call duration & previous campaign success were top predictors
  • 50/50 train-validation split; data preprocessed with cap/floor & log transforms

02

4P Marketing · Environics Opticks Vididata 2024 · 46 Slides

Toronto Jives with Trader Joe's — GTA Market Expansion Strategy

A full marketing analysis and planning report assessing the viability of Trader Joe's launching in Toronto. Using Environics Opticks Vididata 2024, custom consumer variables were built to identify the ideal GTA target segments, benchmarked against key competitors.

Key Segments Identified

  • Culturally Diverse Families (27%) — 1.7M people, concentrated in Toronto, Brampton & Mississauga
  • Thriving Social Youngins (15%) — 912k people, 86% in downtown Toronto
  • Recommended location: Yonge & Eglinton, where all 3 segments overlap
  • $1M promotional budget across 3 phases: Awareness, Engagement, Decision
  • Local content creators, viral tote bags, and seasonal campaigns for sustainability
